objective: Add a bounded, deterministic local input-image preview to the existing single-image inference workflow so users can confirm the selected file before running inference, while preserving all inference, folder, artifact, export, cancellation, and close contracts.
completion_conditions: Each checkpoint persists its pre-maker baseline, runs its fixed required tests, and receives a read-only verifier PASS based on that checkpoint delta and observed tests without requiring the future final harness.

A bounded reusable Qt component decodes local input images, preserves aspect ratio and orientation where supported, and represents empty or unreadable input without inference, network, CUDA, global caches, or new dependencies.

InferencePage integrates exactly one Single Image preview through existing browse/manual input flow while preserving request mapping, asynchronous lifecycle, folder progress/cancellation, partial export, rerun, close coordination and MainWindow behavior.

A deterministic local qtbot integration and accurate documentation graduate valid/invalid recovery, mode transitions, lifecycle coexistence, resource bounds, compatibility and explicit non-goals without screenshots, arbitrary sleeps, real model inference or fabricated results.

No change occurs outside the seven allowed files and no public inference API, portable artifact, export schema, dependency, launcher, marker registry, goal, manifest, local config, drag-and-drop, folder thumbnail, image editing, result rendering, packaging or TorchScript migration is introduced.

The Phase-wide verifier evaluates the manifest allowed-files union after all checkpoint verifiers pass; only then does the orchestrator run the full harness exactly once, with no model verifier after the harness and no automatic restart of a failed Phase.
